mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.7% signals aggressive monetary accommodation, compressing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.7% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 4.0% indicates labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate synchronized demand and supply chain strength, signaling economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either HOUST or INDPRO declines, or the joint signal produces negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 250 indicates high inflation, triggering expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above the 5-year average indicates robust consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of cases when HOUST exceeds the 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth exceeding 100k/month signals strengthening labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a virtuous cycle of job creation and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either PAYEMS or RSAFS growth is negative, or the joint signal produces negative returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 103.0 in early-cycle expansion indicates strengthening manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO > 103.0 in early-cycle expansion.
